messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change only the person's one-piece garment to match the reference images (front and back views). Preserve the garment's design, color, pattern, and details from the references. Leave the rest of the outfit and everything else in the video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change only the person's one-piece garment to match the reference images. Leave the rest of the outfit and everything else in the video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on an asphalt road, initially facing forward, then turns his head and body to the right, briefly raises his right hand to his chest, and then returns to a standing position.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot that keeps the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A light blue and white plaid button-down shirt with rolled-up sleeves, brown leather suspenders, grey plaid trousers with cuffed hems, and brown leather shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair pulled back into a high ponytail with a green band or accessory.","identity":"A 3D-rendered adult male character with a slim build, light brown skin, and a short beard.","scene":"An outdoor urban environment under a concrete overpass or bridge, with a metal railing, red and yellow striped bollards, and a construction crane visible in the background under a blue sky with clouds."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's dark grey military-style uniform was replaced with a light blue/white plaid button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, brown leather suspenders, and grey plaid cuffed trousers, matching the front and back reference garment. The character's pose, scene, camera, and general appearance remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the person's one-piece garment to match the reference images, preserving its design, color, pattern, and details while leaving the rest of the outfit and everything else unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the shoes were intentionally changed or if this is a rendering artifact.
unexpected_changes: The character's shoes appear to have changed from brown boots to brown loafers/leather shoes.
